# ZeAllgrate - FRP Grating Manufacturer

> Professional FRP/GRP grating manufacturer since 2004. 20+ years of experience producing molded and pultruded fiberglass grating, covers, profiles, handrails, clips and fiberglass fabrics for corrosive and heavy-duty industrial applications. ISO 9001 certified, exported to 40+ countries.

## Products

- [FRP Molded Grating](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/molded): Bidirectional strength, corrosion resistant, customizable sizes for industrial walkways and platforms
- [FRP Pultruded Grating](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/pultruded): Heavy-duty load bearing, large span capability for mining and offshore platforms
- [FRP Covers & Panels](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/covers): Trench covers, tank sealing covers, cable trench covers, equipment protective panels
- [FRP Profiles](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/profiles): I-beam, channel, angle, square tube, round tube, flat bar fiberglass structural shapes
- [FRP Handrail & Stair](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/handrail): Corrosion resistant safety railing system for industrial platforms
- [Fiberglass Fabric](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/fabric): E-glass C-glass woven roving cloth for FRP composite molding
- [FRP Grating Clips](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/clips): SS304 SS316 M-clip C-clip L-clip Z-clip fasteners for grating installation
- [Fiberglass Mesh & Tape](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/product/fiberglass-mesh-tape): Alkali-resistant mesh, self-adhesive tape for wall insulation and pipe repair

## Applications

- [Wastewater Treatment](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/wastewater): Anti-corrosion walkways under sewage and chemical erosion
- [Petrochemical](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/petrochemical): Platforms and walkways in aggressive chemical plants
- [Marine & Offshore](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/marine): Jetty decks, walkways and handrails for marine use
- [Solar PV Walkway](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/solar): O&M platforms that resist UV and stay non-conductive
- [Car Wash Floor](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/carwash): Durable anti-slip flooring for wet wash bays
- [Mining Industry](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/mining): Heavy-duty walkways and platforms for harsh mining sites
- [Railway Infrastructure](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/railway): Non-conductive access systems for rail facilities
- [Jetty & Pontoon](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/jetty): Corrosion-proof decking for waterfront structures
- [Municipal & Public Works](https://www.gratingfrp.com/#/app/municipal): Durable FRP infrastructure for bridges and public facilities
